pattern.title: Use of the METS structural map.

rule.assert: CSIP81;ERROR;The mets/structMap/@TYPE attribute must take the value “PHYSICAL” from the vocabulary.
CSIP82;ERROR;The mets/structMap/@LABEL attribute value is set to “CSIP” from the vocabulary.
CSIP83;ERROR;An xml:id identifier for the structural description (structMap) used for internal package references. It must be unique within the package.
CSIP84;ERROR;The structural map MUST comprises a single division.
CSIP85;ERROR;An xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.
CSIP88;ERROR;The metadata referenced in the administrative and/or descriptive metadata section is described in the structural map with one sub division.
CSIP90;ERROR;The metadata division div element's @LABEL attribute value must be "Metadata".
CSIP93;WARN;The documentation referenced in the file section file groups is described in the structural map with one sub division.
CSIP95;ERROR;The documentation division div element in the package uses the value "Documentation" from the vocabulary as the value for the @LABEL attribute.
CSIP97;WARN;The schemas referenced in the file section file groups are described in the structural map within a single sub-division.
CSIP99;ERROR;The schema division div element's @LABEL attribute has the value Schemas from the vocabulary.

CSIP101;WARN;When no representations are present the content referenced in the file section file group with @USE attribute value “Representations” is described in the structural map as a single sub division.
CSIP103;ERROR;The package's content division div element must have the @LABEL attribute value "Representations", taken from the vocabulary.

CSIP105;WARN;When a package consists of multiple representations, each described by a representation level METS.xml document, there should be a discrete representation div element for each representation.
CSIP89;ERROR;An xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.

assert.test: every $admid_part in tokenize(@ADMID, '\s+') satisfies some $id in /mets:mets/mets:amdSec/*[@STATUS = 'CURRENT']/@ID satisfies $admid_part = $id

rule.assert: CSIP91;ERROR;The admimistrative metadata division should reference all current administrative metadata sections.

assert.test: every $dmdid_part in tokenize(@DMDID, '\s+') satisfies some $id in /mets:mets/mets:dmdSec/*[@STATUS = 'CURRENT']/@ID satisfies $dmdid_part = $id

rule.assert: CSIP92;ERROR;The descriptive metadata division should reference all current descriptive metadata sections.
CSIP94;ERROR;An xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.
CSIP96;ERROR;All file groups containing documentation described in the package are referenced via the relevant file group identifiers. There MUST be one file group reference per fptr element.
CSIP116;ERROR;A reference, by ID, to the “Documentation” file group.
CSIP98;ERROR;An xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.
CSIP100;ERROR;All file groups containing schemas described in the package are referenced via the relevant file group identifiers. There MUST be one file group reference per fptr element.
CSIP118;ERROR;The pointer to the identifier for the “Schema” file group.
CSIP102;ERROR;An xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.
CSIP104;ERROR;All file groups containing documentation described in the package are referenced via the relevant file group identifiers. There MUST be one file group reference per fptr element.
CSIP119;ERROR;The pointer to the identifier for the Representations file group.
CSIP106;ERROR;Mandatory, xml:id identifier must be unique within the package.

CSIP107;ERROR;The package's representation division div element @LABEL attribute value must be the path to the representation level METS document starting with the value "Representations" followed by the main folder name for example "Representations/submission" and "Representations/ingest".
CSIP109;ERROR;The division div of the specific representation includes one occurrence of the METS pointer mptr element, pointing to the appropriate representation METS file.
CSIP108;ERROR;The file group containing the files described in the package are referenced via the relevant file group identifier.
CSIP110;ERROR;MUST point to the actual location of the resource. We recommend recording a URL type filepath within this attribute.
CSIP111;ERROR;Attribute used with the value “simple”. Value list is maintained by the xlink standard.
CSIP112;ERROR;The locator type is always used with the value “URL” from the vocabulary in the attribute.
